2. Succinctly, the genesis of the present proceedings is a complaint filed by Sh. Bishan Chandra, Sub.
Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Paharganj, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as the 'complainant'),
regarding the receipt of information of fake affidavit of one, Smt. Anita, W/o. Shri. Rajinder.
Markedly, under his complaint the complainant inter alia proclaimed that an information was
received from Smt. Anita, avowing that one Affidavit in her name had been obtained in a fraudulent
manner, by forging her/Smt. Anita's signatures by her brother, Shri Raj Kumar Sharma. In
particular, it was specifically asserted under the complaint that the said forgery was committed by
Shri. Raj Kumar Sharma, with an intention to grab her/Smt. Anita's share in property as well as the
money in her bank account. The complainant further declared under his complaint that the said
Affidavit was attested by forging the stamp of the Office of SDM, Paharganj, besides the same was

never attested by him/the complainant. Ergo, under said facts and circumstances, the complainant
forwarded his complaint along with the complaint/information received from Smt. Anita to the
concerned police official(s)/police station, which was eventually marked to the concerned police
station/PS. Paharganj, whereupon the instant FIR came to be registered, and investigation ensued.
Relevantly, during the course of ensuing investigation, statements of various ABHISHEK GOYAL

investigation of the present case was marked to the Anti-Forgery Section, EOW, Crime Branch. 2.1.
Noticeably, during the course of ongoing investigation, Shri. Bhushan Sharma, younger brother of
Shri. Raj Kumar Sharma was obtained, wherein he specifically stated that he had not signed any
Affidavit, and that the Affidavit submitted in bank was forged. Correspondingly, statement of the
stamp vendor, namely, Suresh Chand Gupta was recorded, who inter alia avowed that on
31.01.2005, Shri. Raj Kumar Sharma purchased two stamp paper of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only)
denomination, bearing SL Nos. 51231 and 51232. Congruently, the concerned Investigating
Officer/IO, obtained access to the original Will of Late Smt. Parvati Sharma, dated 10.05.2002,
which was filed before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi. Consequently, by seeking recourse to the
process of photography and preliminary examination by experts of FSL/forensic science
laboratory/fingerprints bureau, the said documents were subjected to examination.
Correspondingly, specimen/admitted signatures/handwriting of witnesses/suspects/accused were
obtained and an opinion from Fingerprint Bureau/FSL was obtained. Remarkably, the opinion of
such experts inter alia determined that; '(i) the signatures of SDM, Paharganj were forged; (ii)
official seal of SDM, Paharganj was forged; (iii) signatures of Smt. Parvati Sharma on the Will, dated
10.05.2002 were genuine; (iv) signatures of Smt. Anita Sharma on the Affidavit were genuine; (v)
signature of Shri. Bharat Bhushan could not be verified'.
